_meta.file: scan engagement profiles. Keys here override config.json for the selected profile.
_meta.profiles: quick | full | vast | stealth | webonly | recon
_meta.ad: AD phase is OFF by default; pass --ad (or --ad-user) to enable it.
_meta.cloud: cloud exposure scan only runs when cloud/CDN tech is detected.

shallow crawl (25 pages), quick dir-busting, no
time-based SQLi, no OOB listener. ~1-3 min/host.

full.label: Full engagement
full.description: 65535 TCP ports, deep wordlists, time-based SQLi, OOB
blind detections, exploitation phase. AD/cloud still
gate on their own enablement conditions.
